title: Highly diverse emission of volatile organic compounds by Sitka spruce and determination of their emission pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,242-260
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00138A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hayley Furnell, John Wenger, Astrid Wingler, Kieran N. Kilcawley, David T. Mannion, Iwona Skibinska, Julien Kammer
Sitka spruce has been found to emit 74 BVOCs with piperitone (C10H16O) being the highest. Most of BVOCs originated from both biosynthetic and pooled pathways simultaneously. Standardised emissions showed that Sitka spruce is a strong BVOC emitter.
